messages:
Olivia Chen: Heads-up: final social push for ModelServe v1.2 needs to be tight. Main goals: webinar signups, demo requests, and PR-ready benchmark assets. Proposed publish cadence: Tue 10am PT (global), repost 2pm PT, APAC-friendly follow-up at 8am SGT next day. Need final copy and assets by EOD tomorrow.

Jamal Reed: Confirming UTMs and lead routing before any publish. Use utm_campaign=msv1_2_launch, utm_source=social, utm_content={slot}. LinkedIn leads -> MKT_LAUNCH_LINKEDIN queue; X replies with demo intent -> MKT_SOCIAL_INBOUND. I'll wire to SFDC.

Sara Patel: Design timeline: we can do 3 hero images + 1 story vertical + 3 small cards for thread. Need exact headline lengths: short (<=55 chars) and long (<=140 chars). Also need alt text for accessibility.

Alex Gomez: Draft X thread (6) and two LinkedIn drafts below. Will own scheduling. Please edit.

Alex Gomez: "Tweet 1: ModelServe v1.2 is live ⚡️ Faster kernels, smarter routing, lower inference cost. Join the launch webinar: [link]
Tweet 2: Why this matters: production apps need predictable latency + cost. v1.2 brings smarter batching + KV caching to reduce tail latency.
Tweet 3: Highlights: up to 3x throughput on long-context workloads; 15–30% token-cost reduction with intelligent quantization.
Tweet 4: Ops-first features: canary rollouts, per-route SLOs, automatic fallback to cheaper model variants.
Tweet 5: We’ll publish benchmark slides and a test-config repo during the webinar. Bring your workload questions.
Tweet 6: Register for live Q&A (APAC-friendly session included): [webinar link] #ModelServe #LLMinfra #RedwoodInference"

Olivia Chen: Looks good. Legal asked to change "up to 3x" to "up to 3x (workload dependent)" in the thread, and we need to mention APAC session in at least 2 posts. Also add company LinkedIn (product + numbers) and founder POV (narrative) drafts here for review.

Alex Gomez: Updated: changed phrasing and added APAC note. Adding LinkedIn drafts.

Alex Gomez: "Company LinkedIn: Today we launch ModelServe v1.2, focused on predictable inference at scale. Teams can expect up to 3x throughput (workload dependent) on long-context workloads and 15–30% lower token costs with new batching and quantization. Join our webinar for real-world benchmarks and a live demo: [link]"

Alex Gomez: "Founder LinkedIn (Maria/Oliver POV): Shipping reliable inference at scale is a grind. Years ago we watched teams throw GPUs at tail latency and still miss SLAs. That drove us to build smarter routing and fallback policies that keep apps online without breaking the bank. ModelServe v1.2 is the next step: simpler rollouts, more predictable latency, and lower unit cost. If you care about reliability in production, join our webinar for the trade-offs and the benchmarks: [link]"

Sara Patel: For the hero overlays, propose short headline: "Predictable inference at scale" (34 chars). Long headline: "ModelServe v1.2: smarter routing, faster kernels, lower token cost" (67 chars). Will make variants for light/dark + alt text.

Ethan Park: For paid boost, recommend target: infra/product managers, platform engineers, and ML infra leads. Budget: small boost for 48 hours on company LinkedIn post to capture demo signups. I'll set audience and tracking.

Maria Liu: Routing checklist: landing form -> SFDC web-to-lead with campaign mapping. utm_content values: company_post, founder_post, x_thread_t1, x_card_1. Lead owner default -> MKT_QUAL queue. SalesOps: create follow-up task (webinar - followup) with 24hr SLA. Social DM demo requests -> create Zendesk ticket tag=social-demo and notify sales slack channel #sales-inbound. APAC leads -> apac-sdr-group.

Olivia Chen: Need three reply templates for social ops (keep short). Drafts below, please tweak.

Alex Gomez: Reply templates:
1) Demo ask: "Thanks! We'd love to show you. Can I DM a short link to pick a 15-min slot?"
2) Webinar signup reply: "Thanks for registering! You should see a calendar invite soon. Anything you'd like us to cover?"
3) Benchmark request: "We’ll share slides in the webinar. Want them earlier? Drop an email and we’ll send the deck."

Sara Patel: Will make CTA buttons on images match the messages: "Register" and "Request demo" variants. Also adding short GIF showing the routing flow for story.

CampaignBot: Event created: ModelServe v1.2 launch - social publish window Tue 10:00 PT.

Jamal Reed: Quick legal check: pinged Legal for the "up to 3x" claim and customer quote usage. Proceed with caution until sign-off.

Olivia Chen: Scheduling plan: X thread at 10:00 PT, single-image X posts at 10:05 and 14:00 PT, company LinkedIn at 10:00 PT, founder LinkedIn at 18:00 PT. Repost X thread at 14:00 PT for US audience, and APAC follow-up post next day 08:00 SGT. Alex will queue everything and hold publish until landing link finalized.

Alex Gomez: Queued drafts in scheduling tool and tagged as "launch". Will set A/B copy for the 14:00 repost (short vs long headline).

Maria Liu: Short link ready: https://rwd.in/msv1-2 (placeholder). Will update utm_content tags when publishing.

DesignBot: Figma upload complete: https://figma.com/file/example/modelserve-v1-2-assets (mock). Alt text included.

Olivia Chen: Owners recap: Alex = copy + scheduling, Sara = design assets, Maria = lead routing + links, Jamal = landing page & legal, Ethan = paid boost, Olivia = final approvals. Please mark done in thread when complete. :thumbsup:

Alex Gomez: All set on my end except live link. Will publish once Olivia confirms final.

Olivia Chen: Confirmed. Publish when legal OKs the claims and Jamal confirms landing link. Thanks all! :rocket:
